reviews.title: Corporate greed at its finest.
reviews.text:
This app used to be free. I used to use it pretty often. Now it's just "Premium this! Premium that! Subscription services!"
And even when you go save an image, there's an option to just save it with a watermark. But then it just forces you into the premium screen, the same as if you selected "remove watermark".
Instagram, this is the simplest app an App Store can have. It does not need a premium subscription service. Make it free. You're not losing anything by making it free.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD -
reviews.text:
I strongly advise avoiding this app. I used it only twice for around 5–10 minutes after downloading it, but later discovered I had been charged £6.99 every week for months, amounting to hundreds of pounds.

The subscription and recurring cost were not clear to me, and the app appeared under a different name in my purchase history, making the charges even harder to identify. I also did not receive clear weekly renewal reminders.

I tried emailing the company multiple times and they do not respond. Apple don’t care either.
